programmes.name_local: Banco Português de Fomento – linhas de crédito e capital
programmes.name_en: Portuguese Development Bank – credit and capital lines
programmes.amount_note: Guaranteed credit lines, capitalisation instruments and fund-of-funds equity for Portuguese SMEs; amounts set per line or fund.
Grant for the creation of new companies with qualified or creative content; aid intensity set per aviso.
Grant for company-led industrial research and experimental development projects, individual or in co-promotion; aid intensity set per aviso.
Grant (and in some avisos repayable incentive) for SME productive investment introducing new products or processes; aid intensity depends on region and company size.

programmes.funder: European Space Agency (ESA) with the national space agency or regional co-funder
programmes.amount_note: EUR 50,000 equity-free funding for product and IP development, plus up to two years of incubation with technical support from ESA experts, business coaching, legal and IPR advice and fundraising support. Some national BICs add local top-up funding.
programmes.deadline_note: This ESA BIC runs its own call cycle with published cut-off dates, typically two to four per year. Contact the local centre for the next deadline.

procedure_steps.detail: Contact the local ESA BIC to discuss suitability
Submit application documents before the local deadline
Tender Opening Board review, then presentation to the Tender Evaluation Board
Register a company in Portugal before signing the incubation contract

eligibility.other_note: Business must use space-based systems, apply space technology in a non-space domain, or develop products and services for the space sector. Company must be registered in Portugal.

programmes.source_snippet: EUR 50k equity free funding for product and IP development

programmes.funder: IAPMEI – Agência para a Competitividade e Inovação, I.P.
programmes.amount_note: Monthly grant of EUR 900 (max 2 grants per project), interim prizes of EUR 1,500 at start of phases 2 and 3, completion prize of EUR 2,000; 9 months in three phases.

procedure_steps.detail: Check eligibility: 'Jovens até aos 29 anos, licenciados ou com grau superior', resident in NUTS II Norte, Centro or Alentejo, with a project at idea stage.
Prepare the application following the Guia de Apoio à Apresentação de Candidatura.
Submit online by the deadline; selected projects run 9 months across three development phases with mentoring and incubator support.
On completion, incorporate the company to receive the EUR 2,000 completion prize.

documents_required.doc: Proof of academic qualification (licenciatura or higher)
Proof of age and residence in NUTS II Norte, Centro or Alentejo

eligibility.other_note: Young people up to 29 with a higher-education degree, not studying, training or working, with tax residence in NUTS II Norte, Centro or Alentejo, with projects at idea stage.

programmes.amount_note: Voucher co-funding incubation services purchased from a certified incubator; value and co-funding rate set in the aviso.
programmes.reopen_note: Vale Incubação has been re-opened under successive EU programming periods (Portugal 2020, now Portugal 2030); check IAPMEI and the COMPETE 2030 aviso calendar.

programmes.name_local: Vouchers para Startups – Novos Produtos Digitais e Tecnológicos
programmes.name_en: Startup Vouchers – New Digital and Technological Products
programmes.amount_note: PRR-funded voucher supporting the development of new digital or technological products by startups; ceiling set in the aviso.
programmes.reopen_note: Delivered under the Recovery and Resilience Plan (PRR); further windows depend on remaining PRR allocation.

programmes.amount_note: No large cash purse. Winners receive exposure, a media package and investor access. The value is the platform rather than the prize.
programmes.deadline_note: Web Summit 2026 takes place 9-12 November 2026; the page gives no PITCH application deadline.
programmes.reopen_note: Runs annually with each Web Summit edition. Apply through the Web Summit startup programme; a paid Startup ticket package is normally required.

eligibility.other_note: Open to ALPHA and BETA startups exhibiting at Web Summit that have received less than EUR 5 million in funding to date and have had no discernible change in business model in the last three years.

programmes.source_snippet: PITCH, brought to you by KPMG, is open to ALPHA and BETA startups exhibiting at Web Summit that have received less than €5 million in funding to date and have not had a discernible change in business model in the last three years.

programmes.name_local: Apoio à Criação do Próprio Emprego por Beneficiários de Prestações de Desemprego (PAECPE)
programmes.name_en: Self-employment support for unemployment-benefit recipients (lump-sum benefit + subsidised credit)
programmes.funder: Instituto do Emprego e Formação Profissional (IEFP)
programmes.amount_note: Receive the whole unemployment benefit in one payment (amounts already received are deducted); can be combined with subsidised, guaranteed bank credit: MICROINVEST (investment up to EUR 20,000, credit up to EUR 20,000) or INVEST+ (investment EUR 20,000 to EUR 200,000, credit up to EUR 100,000), plus free technical support.
programmes.deadline_note: Applications are open continuously at the employment service of your area of residence; IEFP normally answers in 60 to 90 working days.

procedure_steps.detail: Submit the request and a financially viable business project at the IEFP employment service where you live
IEFP gives its opinion and sends it to Social Security, which tells you its decision
If credit is included, present the project and the PAECPE declaration to a participating bank

eligibility.other_note: Must receive unemployment benefit or initial social unemployment benefit and be at least 18; no debts to tax, Social Security or IEFP; project must create at least your own full-time job; keep the business and jobs for at least three years.

programmes.source_snippet: Receba o seu subsídio de uma só vez para criar o seu próprio emprego.

programmes.name_local: Apoios à Criação de Empresas (MICROINVEST e INVEST+)
programmes.name_en: IEFP support for creating small businesses (MICROINVEST and INVEST+ credit)
programmes.funder: Instituto do Emprego e Formação Profissional (IEFP)
programmes.amount_note: Bank loans with mutual guarantee and interest subsidy: MICROINVEST for investment up to EUR 20,000 (credit up to EUR 20,000) and INVEST+ for investment EUR 20,000 to EUR 200,000 (credit up to EUR 100,000). Year 1 no capital or interest, year 2 no capital and part of interest, year 3 capital and part of interest, years 4-5 monthly instalments. Project may create at most 10 jobs.
programmes.deadline_note: Apply to one participating bank (Caixa Geral de Depósitos, Millennium bcp, Novo Banco, Crédito Agrícola, Montepio, ABANCA); only one bank at a time. Open all year.

procedure_steps.detail: Choose one of the participating banks
Present the project to that bank (only one bank at a time)
The bank analyses the request and decides on the loan

eligibility.other_note: Must be registered at an employment centre as unemployed (9 months or less involuntary, or over 9 months), a young first-job seeker aged 18-35 with at least secondary education, never employed, or a self-employed person earning below the minimum monthly wage; at least 18; the company must not yet exist when applying; total investment not above EUR 200,000.

programmes.source_snippet: O IEFP dá-lhe acesso a empréstimos bancários com condições especiais para criar empresas pequenas e com fins lucrativos, incluindo cooperativas.

programmes.funder: Instituto do Emprego e Formação Profissional (IEFP)
programmes.amount_note: MICROINVEST credit for investment up to EUR 20,000 (credit up to EUR 20,000), 5-year term with 2 years capital grace and interest subsidy in the first 3 years, plus free technical support. Priority for people aged 16-34 registered as unemployed for at least 4 months.
programmes.deadline_note: Submit the Business Dossier to IEFP by email, get the IEFP validation document, then apply to a participating bank. Open all year.

procedure_steps.detail: Fill in the Business Dossier and gather the documents
Email the signed dossier and documents to microcredito@iefp.pt
Take the IEFP validation document and the project to a participating bank

eligibility.other_note: People with difficulty accessing the labour market and at risk of social exclusion with an entrepreneurial profile, or micro-entities and cooperatives with up to 10 workers creating new jobs; at least 16 years old; no bank problems; at most 10 jobs created; people who already received MICROINVEST or INVEST+ cannot use this route.

programmes.source_snippet: O Programa Nacional de Microcrédito facilita o acesso a financiamento de pequeno montante para começar ou ampliar um negócio.

programmes.name_local: Apoio Técnico à Criação e Consolidação de Projetos (ATCP)
programmes.name_en: Free technical support for creating and consolidating business projects (ATCP)
programmes.funder: Instituto do Emprego e Formação Profissional (IEFP)
programmes.amount_note: Free technical support before project approval (entrepreneurial skills, project set-up, investment and business plan) and during the first two years of activity (monitoring, management consulting), delivered by accredited non-profit entities and municipalities.
programmes.deadline_note: Open all year to unemployed people registered with IEFP; delivered through the network of accredited support entities (EPAT).

procedure_steps.detail: Check the list of accredited support entities (EPAT) for your municipality
Request support through IEFP or an EPAT

eligibility.other_note: Unemployed people registered with IEFP who want to develop a project to create their own job or company; the support is free and can be used with the other PAECPE measures.

programmes.source_snippet: O Apoio Técnico à Criação e Consolidação de Projetos (ATCP) é um apoio para quem quer criar o seu próprio emprego ou empresa.

programmes.name_en: COMPETE 2030 STEP Productive Innovation – Clean Energy technologies
programmes.funder: COMPETE 2030 / Programa Inovação e Transição Digital (Portugal 2030), managed with IAPMEI
programmes.amount_note: Grant (FEDER) up to 70% co-financing, capped by the regional aid map; EUR 100,000,000 indicative allocation. Supports productive investment to manufacture critical clean-technology products, components, critical raw materials and related services.

procedure_steps.detail: Check the notice and annexes on the COMPETE 2030 site
Submit the application through Balcão 2030 (Portugal 2030 applications portal) before 4 January 2027, 17:00

eligibility.other_note: Companies of any size with organised accounts meeting Portugal 2030 eligibility; investment in Norte, Centro or Alentejo (NUTS II); must be an initial investment (new establishment, diversification or fundamental process change). Co-financing rate is capped at 70% and by the regional aid map.

programmes.source_snippet: Operações de investimento produtivo nos setores estratégicos da Plataforma de Tecnologias Estratégicas para a Europa (STEP), que visem o fabrico de tecnologias críticas

programmes.name_local: STEP – Inovação Produtiva – Digital e Biotecnologia
programmes.name_en: COMPETE 2030 STEP Productive Innovation – Digital, deep tech and Biotechnology
programmes.funder: COMPETE 2030 / Programa Inovação e Transição Digital (Portugal 2030), managed with IAPMEI
programmes.amount_note: Grant (FEDER) up to 70% co-financing, capped by the regional aid map; EUR 107,950,000 indicative allocation (EUR 100,000,000 PITD plus EUR 7,950,000 Algarve). Supports productive investment to manufacture critical digital, deep-tech and biotech products, components and services.

procedure_steps.detail: Check the notice and annexes on the COMPETE 2030 site
Submit the application through Balcão 2030 before 4 January 2027, 17:00

eligibility.other_note: Companies of any size with organised accounts meeting Portugal 2030 eligibility; investment in Norte, Centro, Alentejo or Algarve (Algarve needs a separate application); must be an initial investment (new establishment, diversification or fundamental process change).

programmes.source_snippet: Operações de investimento produtivo nos setores estratégicos da Plataforma de Tecnologias Estratégicas para a Europa (STEP), que visem o fabrico de tecnologias críticas

programmes.name_local: STEP – I&D&I Empresarial – Digital e Biotecnologia
programmes.name_en: COMPETE 2030 STEP Business R&D&I – Digital, deep tech and Biotechnology
programmes.funder: COMPETE 2030 / Programa Inovação e Transição Digital (Portugal 2030), managed with IAPMEI
programmes.amount_note: Grant (FEDER) up to 80% co-financing of the R&D component (85% if a non-business research entity is a partner); EUR 76,000,000 indicative allocation (EUR 75,000,000 PITD plus EUR 1,000,000 Algarve). Co-promotion between companies and/or research entities, TRL 4 to TRL 9.
programmes.deadline_note: Applications 30 September 2026 to 4 January 2027 (17:00; the page text prints the year as 2026 but the call header gives 04/01/2027).

procedure_steps.detail: Form a co-promotion consortium with companies and/or research entities
Submit the application through Balcão 2030 before 4 January 2027, 17:00

eligibility.other_note: Companies of any size (and non-business research entities as co-promoters); co-promotion required; R&D at TRL 4 upward must be complemented by productive investment; regions Norte, Centro, Alentejo, Algarve.

programmes.source_snippet: Operações integradas de investigação, desenvolvimento e inovação empresarial (I&D&I) que visem o desenvolvimento e fabrico de tecnologias críticas

programmes.name_local: SIID – I&D Empresarial – Demonstradores Individuais e em Copromoção
programmes.funder: COMPETE 2030 / Programa Inovação e Transição Digital (Portugal 2030), managed with IAPMEI
programmes.amount_note: Grant (FEDER) up to 80% co-financing (40% in Lisboa; 85% with research-entity co-promoter outside Lisboa); EUR 12,500,000 total indicative allocation. Funds demonstrator and pilot-line projects built on completed R&D, and Phase I/II clinical trials.

procedure_steps.detail: Prepare a demonstrator project based on successfully completed R&D
Submit through Balcão 2030 before 29 December 2026, 17:00

eligibility.other_note: Micro, small and medium enterprises and small mid-caps with organised accounts; industrial research may not exceed 25% of the proposed investment; regions Norte, Centro, Lisboa, Alentejo, Algarve.

programmes.source_snippet: Projetos Demonstradores, realizados por empresas na modalidade individual ou liderados por empresas e realizados em copromoção

programmes.name_local: SICE – Inovação Produtiva – Territórios Baixa Densidade e Outros Territórios
programmes.name_en: COMPETE 2030 Productive Innovation for SMEs – low-density and other territories
programmes.funder: COMPETE 2030 / Programa Inovação e Transição Digital (Portugal 2030), managed with IAPMEI
programmes.amount_note: Grant (FEDER) up to 60% co-financing in most regions (40% Lisboa, 50% Algarve), capped by the regional aid map; EUR 182,500,000 indicative allocation (EUR 71,000,000 for low-density territories).
programmes.deadline_note: Applications ran 15 June 2026 to 30 September 2026; the closing date was extended to 30 October 2026 only for COMPETE 2030 applicants whose MPr-2025-9 application still has no decision proposal.
programmes.reopen_note: Check the COMPETE 2030 notices page and the annual notices plan for the next productive-innovation call.

eligibility.other_note: Micro, small and medium enterprises with organised accounts; initial investment in an innovative activity (new establishment, capacity increase, diversification or fundamental process change); regions Norte, Centro, Lisboa, Alentejo, Algarve.

programmes.source_snippet: Operações individuais de investimento produtivo em atividades inovadoras, promovidas por PME, nos territórios de baixa densidade e nos outros territórios.

programmes.name_en: COMPETE 2030 Decarbonisation and Energy Efficiency incentives for companies
programmes.funder: COMPETE 2030 / Programa Inovação e Transição Digital (Portugal 2030), managed with IAPMEI
programmes.amount_note: Grant (FEDER) up to 85% co-financing in the General Regime; EUR 165,000,000 FEDER indicative allocation (national allocation up to EUR 150,000,000 per year); contractual regime (RCI) for large companies negotiated case by case.
programmes.deadline_note: General Regime phases closed on 27 February 2026 and 29 May 2026; phase 3 (to 30 December 2026, 18:00) is only for large companies under the contractual investment regime (RCI).
programmes.reopen_note: Phase 3 until 30 December 2026 accepts only large-company RCI applications.

eligibility.other_note: Companies of any size in the General Regime for continental Portugal (Norte, Centro, Alentejo, Algarve); RCI is open to large companies only.

programmes.source_snippet: Operações que visem a redução dos consumos de energia e das emissões de gases com efeito de estufa (GEE)
